messages:
lina_marketing: Quick sync — final pass on the hosted / dedicated / private landing pages + launch post cadence and webinar gating. Goal: ship copy freeze by EOD Thursday. Can people drop hero variants, benchmark bullets, and the inbound routing rules here?

devon_pm: I'll own the routing rules. High level: demo requests -> AE, self-serve signups -> growth, compliance inquiries -> sales_eng. Need exact form fields to map.

elena_copy: Working through hero lines. Drafts: 
- Hosted API: "Production LLM inference at API speed — low latency, predictable costs."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPU throughput for mission-critical apps."
- Private: "Bring inference behind your VPC — compliance-ready."
Which tone should we push? direct or benefit-led?

ash_design: Benefit-led feels better for landing. Shorten to 6–8 words for hero. Also need supporting subheads for benchmarks (p95 lat, tokens/sec, cost/unit).

sam_growth: For launch posts + webinar promos: emphasize real-cost benchmarks. e.g., "Reduce per-token spend by up to 3x with batching + KV cache". We should surface a 1-line case study in the signup modal.

kevin_prod: From product POV: include a tiny callout for model compatibility and rollouts — folks ask if they can pin versions. Suggest subcopy: "Pin model versions and roll out safely across environments."

elena_copy: OK variants for CTAs: 
- Try hosted (button) -> "Start free API key"
- Get dedicated -> "Talk to sales"
- Explore private -> "Request private demo"
Also microcopy for webinar gate: "Get the cost & latency benchmark deck — register for the webinar"

devon_pm: Routing mapping prototype (will wire to HubSpot form):
```json
{
  "fields": [
    {"name": "company_size", "route": {"<50": "growth", "50-500": "ae", ">500": "enterprise"}},
    {"name": "use_case", "route": {"prototype": "growth", "production": "ae", "regulatory": "sales_eng"}},
    {"name": "interest", "route": {"hosted": "growth", "dedicated": "ae", "private": "enterprise"}}
  ]
}
```
This is a draft — @lina_marketing can you confirm fields we actually want to collect?

lina_marketing: Add a checkbox for "benchmark deck" on the webinar form so we can count downloads vs attendees. Also capture "expected Qx deploy" (quarter) to prioritize leads.

ash_design: For the landing page benchmark block — propose 3 stat tiles: p95 latency (ms), tokens/sec (on standard model), and average cost/token. Quick SVGs + copy.

elena_copy: Micro-head for benchmark tile: "Real workload numbers — not synthetic tests". Short bullets beneath each tile: one-sentence context + link to full benchmark doc.

sam_growth: For the launch post drafts, I'll prep 3 snippets: 1) hero tweet, 2) LinkedIn post with customer angle, 3) webinar blurb. Will post by tomorrow AM for review.

kevin_prod: Reminder: we need a fallback blurb for when dedicated capacity is full — what to show? Maybe "Reserve capacity or try hosted with priority burst". Keeps the conversion path open.

elena_copy: CTA variants to A/B: 
A) "Start free API key" (primary) + "Compare modes" (secondary)
B) "See benchmarks" (primary) + "Get a private demo" (secondary)
Which one drives more demo signups vs immediate self-serve? We should test on a small % first.

devon_pm: I'll add experiment flag in the form so we can split traffic. Add event names: `landing_experiment_variant` and `webinar_gate_download`.

deploy-bot: Reminder: copy freeze scheduled at 2024-11-15T23:59:00Z. Any copy merged after that will be excluded from launch assets.

lina_marketing: Next actions: @elena_copy finalize hero + CTAs (today), @ash_design mock tiles + modal (tomorrow AM), @devon_pm wire routing + flags (end of day), @sam_growth draft launch posts (tomorrow AM). We'll reconvene after copy pass. :+1:
